author: ZelenskyyUa
text:
I met with President of Türkiye @RTErdogan. I thanked him for Türkiye’s consistent support for Ukraine’s territorial integrity and sovereignty. And it is truly very important that Russia’s war against Ukraine ends in exactly this way – with dignity and respect for international law. 

We discussed security in the Black Sea, first and foremost how to ensure the operation of the maritime export corridor. In fact, there are countries on every continent that depend on our food exports. And there are now various options on the table for how the corridor can be fully restored. What is needed is simply Russia’s readiness to stop its terrorist strikes on our infrastructure, so that Ukraine can reciprocally halt its long-range responses. 

I also briefed Mr. President on our contacts with the American team. We discussed bilateral issues as well – the free trade area and a potential Drone Deal. I am grateful to Türkiye for its readiness to help advance peace.
